---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new behaviour, personality, or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What you'd like**
A clear description of the feature or behaviour.

**Why**
What it adds to the pet / who it helps.

**Notes**
Anything about how it might fit — relevant files (see the Contributing section of the
README), constraints (e.g. must keep the zero-permission property), prior art.
